newsitem.title: UK: Cocoa down amid lack of interest.
newsitem.headline: Cocoa down amid lack of interest.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa ended down after a day characterised by a lack of interest, traders said.
"It didn't know what to do, and found its way down," one trader said.
Despite its poor performance, sterling was still too high to encourage industry buyers into the market, he said. "It's still quite expensive to buy," he said.
He felt that, on a technical basis, cocoa looked like it wanted to go up. But it needed a push and the interest which would do it was not there.
Others felt that coffee was occupying market players' attention, keeping them away from the cocoa market.
